name: Fart
concept: Shrek spins three times faster, blanketing nearby enemies in gas. Original damage and 2 MP cost; 25% poison chance, respecting immunity.

name: Eye Lasers
concept: Paired beams sweep the original line target, with brief flame flashes on hit. Air damage and the source 2 MP cost; no added burn status.

name: My Swamp!
concept: “What are you doing in my swamp?!” The roar sends shockwaves across the scene; one selected enemy takes the original Air damage.

name: Swamp Piledriver
concept: Grab one enemy, jump, somersault, and slam it down. Large, flying and rooted enemies stay anchored. Single-target physical damage; no new stun.

name: Run Away!
concept: “This is the part where you run away.” Shrek plants his feet, inhales and roars sparks into a storm over every enemy that did not. Original Air damage and 8 MP cost; no added status.
status: native-label; source-mechanics; native-planted-roar; native-mouth-poses; native-storm; native-audio

name: Four Layer Slam

name: Hi-Yah!
